nodes.text: Welcome. Let's decode today's events into growth signals.
Think of a moment today where things felt 'stuck'. What was your first thought?

options.text: I need to find a workaround.
This is a systemic failure beyond me.

nodes.text: You're seeing the 'internal lever'. Even in friction, you maintain the driver's mindset.
Acknowledge the external constraints, but don't let them define your perimeter of action.
Shifting focus: From your power to your presence in the team...
Which of these captures your 'extra' effort today?

options.text: I cleaned up a process/mess I didn't create.
I focused on hitting my own high-quality targets.
I felt my time was wasted on others' incompetence.

nodes.text: That is Organizational Citizenship. You are investing in the ecosystem, not just your role.
Protecting your time is vital, but ensure your boundaries don't become barriers.
Final scan: The radius of your concern.
When you imagine today's work 'winning', who is smiling in your head?

options.text: The end-user—their pain point was solved.

nodes.text: Self-actualization is the base. Transcendence is the peak. Try looking one step outward tomorrow.
Altrocentrism detected. You're finding meaning in the success of the collective.
